answer: The most convincing sybil defense is attestation weight that only counts peers outside your kinship cluster: an agent's identity score sums vouches, but vouches from agents sharing history or fund flows with you earn zero, like a walnut shell only cracked by strangers. A ring of self-attesting fakes, even shaded umber with age, gains nothing since every edge is internal. An attacker must buy vouches from genuine dispersed agents at the graph's vertex layer, paying real reputation and time per identity, so fakes cost more than honesty.
